original_test_intent: Directly observe the identified CRPS PSU LED and verify that it repeats the vendor-defined blink pattern, color and timing in the approved operating condition, distinguishing the intended code from transient, standby, identification, warning or fault behavior.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the PSU and starting state, observes the physical bezel for the defined window, measures or records the on/off cadence and color across repeated cycles, and captures identity-linked video or timed observations. The agent may analyze the submitted sequence and collect read-only context but cannot originate the physical observation.
manual_activity: The operator verifies the target PSU, directly observes the indicator through multiple cycles, records color, on/off durations, cadence and transitions, and captures a time-bearing visual sequence without touching the module.
required_inputs: Target CRPS slot/serial and indicator location
Operating condition that should produce the blink code
Required color, on/off cadence or frequency, duty cycle and tolerance
Observation duration and minimum repeated cycles
Expected PSU/BMC health context and excluded fault/identify codes
Qualified observer, time-linked recording method and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not manipulate, unlatch, reseat, remove or power-cycle the PSU to induce or change blinking.
Do not accept remote status, a still image or an unspecified blink as proof of the required timed pattern.
Use a safe viewing position and stop for heat, smoke, arcing, abnormal noise, unexpected power transition or management loss.
Preserve PSU/BMC/SEL and host history rather than clearing it.
Stop on wrong color, cadence, transition or telemetry conflict and do not retry by changing state automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect approved read-only PSU identity, operating state and health context before the observation.
Prepare a cadence/color worksheet and verify the operator recording identifies the correct bezel.
Analyze supplied time-linked video for intervals and repetition as supporting evidence, reporting measurement limits.
Collect post-observation PSU/BMC evidence and raw event deltas without issuing the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected blink code, tolerance and observation window.
Directly observe and record the target physical indicator without manipulating the PSU.
Resolve pattern or telemetry ambiguity against the vendor specification.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The manual-only instruction correctly rejects SSH, but its expected-rate phrase cannot be executed until the platform supplies timing and color semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use project-approved read-only PSU/BMC queries only for identity and operating context. Video timing analysis may support the operator evidence, but no command proves or induces optical blinking.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 remain unchanged. The source provides no color, cadence, duty cycle, tolerance, observation count, trigger command or retry.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture an identity-linked video with reliable timestamps or frame rate across the approved number of cycles, measure on/off intervals and color, and correlate with read-only PSU state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected CRPS PSU, bezel indicator and platform power-state implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU/chassis revision, firmware, LED-code document and capture-tool/frame-rate metadata.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable PSU and chassis LED behavior documentation; no generic blink rate or color is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes cadence, repetition and state correlation auditable instead of relying on an untimed visual statement.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Time-resolved media improves pattern evidence but remains dependent on operator access and verified capture timing.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: PSU identity, trigger state, color/cadence/tolerance, observation cycles and capture metadata.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera frame rate, rolling shutter, exposure and automatic white balance can alias or distort the pattern.

project_override_considerations: The project must supply the expected code and may choose observation cycles or recording equipment. Report measured coverage and tolerances; do not treat any repeated light as passing or silently substitute a different vendor's blink semantics.
expected_evidence: CRPS identity, approved operating state and vendor blink-code reference
Required color, cadence/duty cycle, tolerance and observation window
Operator worksheet and time-linked video showing repeated physical pattern
Raw read-only PSU/BMC state and preserved event delta
Measurement limitations, discrepancies and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently request blinking. Undefined timing and color make the common row incomplete for execution but do not create contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical intent is clear. Project-specific code and tolerance are readiness inputs, so the library case is not permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep NO/manual-only but make the missing expected rate, color and observation window explicit rather than implied.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with the time-dependent manual classification and contextual telemetry; strengthen capture timing and aliasing limitations.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical acquisition, optional video analysis, readiness and engineer verdict without inventing a blink code.

review_improvement: This record treats blinking as a measurable sequence rather than a binary visual state. It prevents acceptance of an arbitrary fault/identify pattern and defines how timed media can support, but not replace, the operator's physical observation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Blink color and timing are physical, time-varying outputs, so the full case remains MANUAL ONLY. An agent can quantify operator-supplied video, yet it cannot access the bezel or establish the approved state. Missing cadence and tolerance are project inputs, not permission to guess or a permanent review block.

no_automatic_retry: If the state or target is uncertain, the pattern is wrong/ambiguous, or power/management changes, preserve the recording and telemetry and stop. Do not alter power, clear faults, trigger another sequence, reseat/unlatch the PSU, reboot or power-cycle automatically.
